lines.text: Tyre gloats over ruined Jerusalem, so the Lord GOD says He is against Tyre and will raise up many nations.
Nations will destroy Tyre's walls and towers, making her a bare rock where nets are spread.
God will bring Sennacherib king of Assyria from the north against Tyre, with horses, chariots, siege works and battering rams.
His horses will trample the streets, her stones will be thrown into the valley, and her songs will be silenced.
The princes of the sea will lament Tyre, and mighty waters will cover her until she is no more.
